items: A work permit must be issued.

The maintenance staff should be trained, qualified, and carry 
 the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required

The safety department must check the isolation and surrounding 
 of the zone of work.

Wear the appropriate safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 shoes, helmet, breathing mask, safety glasses.
The unit is out of service.
Put red tag on the high pressure economizer.

Complete maintenance tool set includes screw drivers and 
 common keys

Fill the 
 high pressure section by filling water from feed water pump after closing 
 drain and opening the vents.

Make 
 hydraulic pressure test for the high pressure section by running the feed 
 water pump to operating pressure (60 bar)

Check the 
 distance between pipes is equal.

Check the 
 cleanliness of the surface of pipes.

Check any 
 cracks and use grinding and argon welding according to the manual.

Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued.

A work permit must be issued.
The maintenance staff should be trained, qualified, and carry

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
The safety department must check the isolation and surrounding 
 of the zone of work.
Wear the appropriate safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 shoes, helmet, breathing mask, safety glasses.
The unit is out of service.
Put red tag on the high pressure economizer.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set includes screw drivers and 
 common keys
Argon welding machine
Grinder & grinding wheel
Cleaning fluid.
Work to be Carried Out
Fill the 
 high pressure section by filling water from feed water pump after closing 
 drain and opening the vents.
Inspect and 
 adjust the leakage.
Drain the 
 high pressure economizer.
Make 
 hydraulic pressure test for the high pressure section by running the feed 
 water pump to operating pressure (60 bar)
Check the 
 distance between pipes is equal.
Check the 
 cleanliness of the surface of pipes.
Check any 
 cracks and use grinding and argon welding according to the manual.
